farnham.snapshot: Farnham is a Surrey market town where the network build and the cabling trade both run hard. National build contractors and structured-cabling firms field crews and buy through trade accounts, while ex-BT sole traders and one-van broadband and CCTV installers order direct online with no account. We run both routes side by side, kitting the fleet engineer and the single installer in the same branded polo, hi-vis and softshell.
farnham.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Farnham and Surrey
s1loc: Farnham sits in the middle of a busy full-fibre build. Openreach has started a new full fibre network across the town, using existing ducts and poles where it can and pushing fibre out through Hale, Wrecclesham, Badshot Lea and the Weydon district, and alt-nets are building alongside, with Box Broadband, now part of Community Fibre, and other Surrey full-fibre operators active locally. The work feeds the national delivery partners and civils contractors who put engineers on the streets of Farnham, plus a long tail of ex-BT subcontractors taking on broadband, fibre and CCTV jobs around the town and out toward Aldershot and Farnborough.

Alongside the residential rollout sits a solid commercial scene. Structured-cabling and network installers wire offices, schools and multi-site businesses in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre across Farnham Business Park and Frensham House on Weydon Lane, Coxbridge Business Park and the Romans Business Park units on East Street, with retail and leisure premises through the town centre adding CCTV and access-control work. It is the sort of mixed estate-and-high-street trade that keeps cabling firms, alarm engineers and independent installers busy right across the Waverley area.
